race.comment: COBBLESTONE WAY (3) is the one to beat after a strong third at Sale on heavy ground, where he led and was beaten just over a length on a 10-day back-up into this. His Geelong run prior was better than it reads after being held up, and his wet-track record gives him the right platform. REGAL TYCOON (2) returns from a five-week let-up after finishing third at Cranbourne, beaten just over a length in metro company, and the move to easier company with Jamie Mott back aboard is a genuine positive. DELIVERING (1) was second to Aurora Belle at Geelong at long odds and is proven around this distance, with the 3kg claim helping offset the weight. CORONATIONHERCULES (7) has to rebound from a plain Horsham seventh, but his Mornington BM62 win two back and first-time blinkers keep him in the mix.
